cloud.title: Cloud sync
cloud.lede: Your account keeps Meletee in sync on all your devices. It’s the same account as noema-lite.
cloud.sameAccount: The same account as noema-lite. Your data is private to you.
cloud.name: Your name
cloud.recoverSent: Check your inbox for a reset link 📬
cloud.confirmEmail: Almost there! Confirm your e-mail, then sign in ✉️
cloud.restoreLede: Meletee saves a restore point every day. Go back to one if something went wrong.
cloud.noPoints: No restore points yet. The first one is made today.
cloud.restoreText: Your Meletee data will be replaced by the copy from {date}. Today's data is kept as a restore point first.
cloud.signOutText: Your data stays safe in your account. Sign in again on any device to pick up where you left off.
noema.title: From noema-lite
noema.lede: Bring a noema-lite subject into Meletee. Its chapters become topics with spaced reviews.
noema.signInHint: Sign in to see your own subjects and progress.
noema.empty: No subjects found. Is noema-lite reachable?
noema.packFailed: Couldn't load this subject right now. Try again in a little while.
noema.queueLede: Meletee's reviews and noema-lite's cards and mistakes, in one list.
noema.pending.one: {n} result waits to go back to noema-lite
noema.pending.few: {n} results wait to go back to noema-lite
noema.pending.many: {n} results wait to go back to noema-lite
noema.pending.other: {n} results wait to go back to noema-lite
welcome.title: Welcome to Meletee
welcome.lede: Make a free account, and your progress, notes and history stay safe and follow you to every device.
welcome.localData: We found some study on this device. It moves into your account when you sign in, so nothing is lost.
welcome.withNoema: Sign in with your noema-lite account
welcome.oneAccount: One account works in both apps: same e-mail, same password. A Meletee account signs in here too.
welcome.createLede: It works in noema-lite too, if you ever want it.
welcome.signInLede: Use your noema-lite or Meletee account: they are one and the same.
welcome.resetSent: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way 📬
welcome.confirmText: We sent a link to {email}. Tap it to confirm your e-mail, then come back and sign in.
welcome.bringingText: Gathering your courses, notes and history. Just a moment ☁️
welcome.offlineLater: Offline for now: your study comes over as soon as you’re connected.
welcome.err.offline: You seem to be offline. Connect once to sign in; after that, Meletee works offline too.
welcome.err.credentials: That e-mail and password don’t match. Try again, or reset your password.
welcome.err.unconfirmed: Confirm your e-mail first: the link is in your inbox ✉️
welcome.err.exists: There’s already an account with this e-mail (maybe from noema-lite). Sign in instead.
welcome.err.weak: Pick a password with at least 8 characters.
welcome.err.slow: Too many tries for now. Wait a minute and try again.
welcome.linkExpired: That e-mail link has expired or was already used. Sign in, or ask for a new one.
